rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Details
rules.requirement: Name and address of the manufacturer, or the manufacturer and packer if different, or the importer for imported packages.

rules.title: Net Quantity
rules.requirement: Net quantity of the commodity, in terms of standard unit of weight, measure, or number.

rules.title: Month and Year of Manufacture
rules.requirement: The month and year in which the commodity was manufactured, pre-packed, or imported.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.requirement: Retail sale price of the package, inclusive of all taxes.

rules.title: Consumer Care Details
rules.requirement: Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person or office to contact for consumer complaints.
